messages: julian: Proposal: introduce a 'refactor-safety' gate for large modular changes. Block merges unless CI checks: file delta limit, unit coverage floor, perf smoke, and rollback estimate. rhea: +1, we need concrete numbers and an emergency override. noah: prefer a two-path approach: strict gate for >200 files or >X runtime surface, fastpath for docs/small changes. julian: agree. sketch of fastpath: files<=20 OR only /docs -> non-blocking visibility check. noah: automation idea: ./bin/refactor-guard --report -> posts verdict to PR and sets status. ops-bot: scheduled nightly safety suite at 03:30 UTC. julian: I'll draft RFC and PR template sections (Rollback cost, Migration playbook). rhea: please include canary traffic requirement and auto-rollback trigger in runbook.
